title: Lower Shell Lap Joint Land — Detailed Visual and Eddy Current Inspection
abstract: Detailed visual and eddy current inspection of the lower shell lap joint land inside the cargo compartments and the belly fairing, looking for filiform corrosion under the paint film and for lifting of the sealant bead.

sections.purpose: To find filiform corrosion under the paint film at the lower shell lap joint land and to establish whether any finding is inside the allowable damage limits.
sections.job_setup_note: The cargo compartment floor and lining panels along the joint run must be removed and the belly fairing opened. Good local lighting and a magnifier are essential; the early stage of the corrosion is a fine thread under an intact paint film and it is easy to miss. Two persons are needed, one inspecting and one recording. The eddy current operator must be qualified for the technique.
sections.procedure: Get access to the lower shell in zones 131 and 141 and open the belly fairing at zone 191. Remove the floor and lining panels along the joint run. Clean the joint land with the approved solvent and let it dry. WARNING: DO NOT USE A METALLIC SCRAPER ON THE PAINT FILM. THE UNDERLYING SURFACE TREATMENT IS THIN AND WILL BE REMOVED WITH THE PAINT. Do a detailed visual inspection of the whole joint land under magnification, working in 500 mm sections and marking the start of each section. Look for fine thread-like lines under the paint film, for blistering along the fastener row and for lifting at the edge of the sealant bead. Record the position, the length and the direction of every finding. CAUTION: A THREAD THAT CROSSES A FASTENER ROW MUST BE TREATED AS A SINGLE FINDING OF THE FULL LENGTH, NOT AS TWO SHORTER ONES. Where a finding is present, remove the paint locally and measure the depth after blend-out. Do the eddy current inspection at every blended area and at every fastener within 25 mm of a finding. Compare each finding with the allowable damage limits. Refer any finding outside the limits to the repair scheme before further work.
sections.close_out: Re-protect every blended area to the standard practice within the application window. Make sure that no abrasive residue remains in the bilge and that the drain paths are clear. Install the floor and lining panels. Close the belly fairing. Record the inspection, every finding with its position and length, the blend-out depths and the eddy current results.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The inspection interval doubles on aircraft post MOD-111318.

safety_precautions: Do not use a metallic scraper on the paint film.
Provide forced ventilation in the belly fairing.

tooling.description: Eddy current probe set, lap joint
